resources.name: MITRE|CVE
quotes: Mitre maintains arguably the most comprehensive listing of security-critical vulnerabilities through their Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) program [15]

These events, recorded across 63 unique Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), offer a dataset of timelines of real-world exploitation of vulnerabilities ranging from end-of-life router firmware to the notorious Log4Shell vulnerability reported in December 2021.
resources.used_in_paper_reasoning: The paper uses CVE identifiers to track and analyze the lifecycles of 63 specific vulnerabilities, as stated in the Introduction and Background sections.
